title: Daily digest: Level 3 Elevated
message: No new attacks on ships or US bases in the Gulf found since Saturday's two tanker hits; Hormuz stays shut and oil is about US$90. Elsewhere: a Delta computer fault and a Minnesota air-traffic outage delayed US flights (faults, not hacks; no effect on us). To do: avoid mowing or slashing dry grass in the afternoon. Hills fire danger: High today and tomorrow.
